items.title: 21.6 Emission and absorption spectra from different stars (alag alag stars ke spectra) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of emission and absorption spectra from stars (PDF 174-175).

blocks.text: Stars ki surface bohat garam aur dense (ghani, bhari bhari) hoti hai aur taqreeban perfect blackbody ki tarah kaam karti hai, is liye stars continuous spectrum (baghair gap ke rangon ki poori patti) wali roshni emit karte hain. Jab yeh roshni star ki bahar wali, kuch thandi atmosphere se guzarti hai to gas ki layers (tahon) ke atoms kuch khaas wavelengths absorb kar lete hain. Yeh woh wavelengths hain jo atoms mein electrons ke aik energy level se doosre mein jane (electronic transitions) ke barabar hain. Is se continuous spectrum mein un jagahon par kaali lines ban jati hain jahan khaas rang absorb ho gaye. Isi ko absorption spectrum kehte hain. Absorb ki hui energy dobara unhi wavelengths par emit hoti hai, lekin yeh photons har direction mein scatter ho jate hain (bikhar jate hain), is liye zameen par dekhne walon tak bohat kam pohanchte hain. Is wajah se hamein aik khaas absorption spectrum milta hai jis mein kuch wavelengths missing hoti hain. Door ke stars aur galaxies ke emission aur absorption spectra mein yeh lines apni maloom laboratory wavelengths se lambi wavelength par nazar aati hain (Fig. 21.5). Is ko redshift kehte hain. Kitab ke mutabiq yeh is liye hota hai ke universe mein safar karte hue photons (roshni) stretch ho jate hain (khinch jate hain) — asal mein roshni ki wavelength lambi ho jati hai.

blocks.alt: Red-Shift. Violet se laal tak do spectra: Sooraj ki roshni ka spectrum aur door ki galaxy ki roshni ka spectrum. Galaxy ki chaar kaali lines Sooraj wali se thori daen taraf hain, aur arrow daen taraf. Neeche arrow chhoti wavelength se lambi wavelength ki taraf.
blocks.caption: Figure 21.5: Sooraj aur door ki galaxies ki roshni ke spectra, wavelength mein redshift (kitab ki Figure 21.5 ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.title: Tidbit! (Dilchasp baat)
blocks.text: Har star ki roshni ki apni pehchan (signature) hoti hai. Us ke emission aur absorption spectra study kar ke scientists maloom kar lete hain ke star kin elements se bana hai.

blocks.prompt: Stars ke spectra mein poori rangon ki patti ke bajaye kaali lines kyun hoti hain?
blocks.explanation: Star ki bahar wali thandi gas kuch khaas wavelengths absorb karti hai (jo us ke atoms ke electron transitions ke barabar hain). Un wavelengths par dobara emit hone wali roshni har direction mein bikhar jati hai, is liye ham tak kam pohanchti hai aur woh wavelengths kaali lines ki tarah nazar aati hain.

items: Stars: continuous spectrum, us par thandi atmosphere ki absorption lines (kaali lines).
Lines elements batati hain; door ki galaxies mein yeh lambi wavelength ki taraf khiski hui hoti hain (redshift).
